sloka: शक्रं याश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणं याश्च योषित: ।सर्वास्तुम्बुरुणा सार्द्धमाह्वये सपरिच्छदा: ॥ २.९१.१८॥
transliteration: śakraṁ yāścopatiṣṭhanti brahmāṇaṁ yāśca yoṣita: ।sarvāstumburuṇā sārddhamāhvaye saparicchadā: ॥ 2.91.18॥

translations.english: I invoke all the women who attend on Indra and Bramha along with tumbur with all their (musical) instruments.
